detector.rule: Nontrivial cell C must occur identically in WL1 variable partition and WL2 diagonal variable partition; then star transpositions from min(C) to every other member must all be exact automorphisms.
detector.exact_group_interpretation: Verified star transpositions generate S_|C|, so every detected cell carries a certified full symmetric action under the scoped direct checks.

semantic_short_circuit.condition: WL1 has zero nontrivial variable classes
semantic_short_circuit.action: Do not execute WL2 for that source; set WL2 execution status SKIPPED_LOGICALLY_IRRELEVANT and detected_cells=[]
semantic_short_circuit.proof: A shared nontrivial WL1/WL2 cell cannot exist if WL1 has no nontrivial cell.

eligibility.ACTIVE_SINGLETON_BOUNDARY: detected exact and local_constraint_count>0 and boundary_variable_count<2
eligibility.ACTIVE_EXACT_SYMMETRY_ELIGIBLE: detected exact and local_constraint_count>0 and boundary_variable_count>=2

freeze_barrier: All 20 source rows and all denominators must be independently recomputed and frozen before any residual branch, R_C, ROBDD, factorization, or Mantequilla execution is permitted.
